title: Buy this fan!
text: Buy this fan!. I bought this for my bedroom window, installed it vertically. The expansions did not expand out far enough to cover the entire height of the window from top to bottom. I purchased soundproof acoustical panels to make up the "gap difference" and the panels worked perfectly. Not too noisy and the air flow is perfect, I would recommend this fan.

product_metadata.title: shinic Twin Window Fan with Remote, 9-Inch Blades Reversible Airflow, Thermostat Control, 3 Speeds, 3 Functions, 23.8"-37" Expandable Width, Window Exchaust Fans for Home Bedroom, ETL Certified
features: 【Reversible Airflow Window Fan】The double window fan can draw in cool air, exhaust hot air, or facilitate air exchange with the outside environment. The Shinic Window Fan offers three modes to cater to your airflow needs. With these versatile options, you can create a refreshing and comfortable atmosphere in your space.

【Remote Control & 3 Wind Speed】At the highest settings, it feels cool even away from the fan. Dual window fan with the functionally remote, which allows you to control the unit without getting out of bed or leaving the sofa, making it convenient.

【Thermostat Control】Programmable Thermostat turns fan off/on to maintain selected comfort level (60℉-85℉). The LED lights can help you visibly keep track of the temperature setting, also show the current room temperature. Designed for ease of use.
【Expandable for Most Windows】Accordion extender screens adjust from 23.8" to 37", pull out the extenders and locked, to secure the twin window fan to most double-hung and slider windows.

【Portable and Safe】In addition, the window fan is equipped with two sturdy detachable legs that can be installed for desktop use. With built-in handle, this window fan can be easy to move to the other room. 1-Year Warranty, ETL Listed, safe to use at home.
You get a 1-year limited warranty on the shinic window fans.
